title: Seamless loader loop
prompt: Make a seamless looping loader, about two seconds, that can play forever without a hitch on the cut.

assertions.statement: Repeated marks in the loader are one duplicator system. Separate copies of the same arc or dash fail.
The loop is checked at 0%, 25%, 50%, 75%, the final in-range frame, and a seam-adjacent frame. Renders exist for those samples. One still fails.

The run does not treat endFrame = N - 1 as a fact until it has sampled the seam. The shipped seamless-loops hint states that rule and also states that api.setFrame clamps silently. The test fails if the agent samples past the end and calls a clamped read a successful seam check.
The final rendered frame is not a duplicate of frame 0 inside the delivered range.

hypothesis.predicted_unskilled_failure: An agent without the skill builds the loader from copied layers, renders one frame, and includes a duplicate terminal frame.
